anchor_definition.anchor_cannot_encode_a_page_grade: the anchor is identical for every page and every question of a property, so its bytes cannot depend on any single page or its authored grade; only the ordered scale content is supplied
anchor_forbidden_content: any stage ordinal or stage heading string
any token drawn from the property grade_order labels
any substring that appears verbatim in a question or page text of the same property
anchor_definition.anchor_never_seen_by_the_frozen_reader_t: no rubric text, property title, description or criterion enters any current ECA feature, target, cache key or reader input; the only model-visible strings today are term.question and page.text
anchor_definition.anchor_text_rule: for each active property, concatenate its five grade_rubrics strings in grade_order, with no ordinal markers, no stage labels, no headings and no separators that encode stage boundaries; this single string is the anchor for that property
anchor_definition.encoding: single text through the same pinned frozen encoder, FP32 final-layer masked mean over non-padding tokens, width 384, separate rubric modality with its own cache key, token limit 128, truncate disabled
anchor_definition.normalization: new train-only per-coordinate mean/std floor 0.01 fit on the distinct anchor features of the optimizer train rows only; frozen at deployment; the page block keeps the unchanged checkpoint normalizer
anchor_definition.properties_covered: only properties active in the authorized phase; anchors for inactive or final-only properties must not be encoded or cached
anchor_definition.source_field: authored property grade_rubrics, an ordered list of five extent stage strings per property, stored with property_id, family, field_code, title, description, criterion, grade_order and questions in the authored private source

Execution is gated on the property-definition audit and the CPU-only augmented linear ceiling screen below.

decision_rule.order: evaluate S0, then S1, then S2; never skip ahead
rules: if S0 fails: design unrunnable; retain audit evidence; stop
if S0 passes and S1 fails: branch 1 (extent identifiability is not the binding constraint at the frozen-representation level); retire rubric grounding; do not fit; do not widen capacity
if S0 passes, S1 passes, and S2 fails any absolute gate: branch 3 (negative evidence for this head route); record the negative; do not widen capacity or add layers

if S0 passes, S1 passes, S2 passes every absolute gate, and the anchor-specific mechanism claim passes: DEV success; branch 2 (replication on seeds 7/11/13 and fresh independently audited wording before any promotion)

if S0 passes, S1 passes, S2 passes every absolute gate, but the anchor-specific mechanism claim fails: branch 1 (the premise is falsified even though absolute metrics passed); retire rubric grounding; do not promote

if S0 passes, S1 passes, S2 improves extent specifically (anchor-specific claim passes) but fails other absolute gates: branch 1 is supported, since extent identifiability improved while the full task still failed; retire rubric grounding and open minimal final-layer encoder adaptation under a separate protocol

design_under_test.concatenation_form: Numerically identical to concatenating htilde_page_j and htilde_anchor into a 768-d vector and applying one bias-bearing 768-to-1 linear map. The additive form is normative; the concatenated form must reproduce it to 1e-6 in a frozen smoke check.
forbidden: wider hidden layer or any GELU/MLP head
new loss family or loss reweighting
anchor text derived from page text, question text, gold, or model outputs
anchor entering targets, metadata, DecisionIR gold or exact facts
any use of the ECA-2 final pool
selection of an arm, threshold, seed or epoch from DEV outcomes
design_under_test.new_arm: pages_rubric_anchor: the frozen PageReader relevance/direction/knownness mechanism with the raw-value map extended from a 384-d page-only input to a 768-d concatenated page-plus-anchor input.
design_under_test.one_sentence: The caller's own ordered per-property rubric becomes an explicit model-visible anchor text alongside the existing question and page text, and one extra frozen-encoder head predicts raw extent from the concatenated train-normalized page and rubric-anchor features.
design_under_test.parameter_delta: exactly +384 trainable scalars (w_r); value path grows from 385 to 769; no hidden layer, no activation, no second layer, no width search
design_under_test.rationale_to_test: Corrected ECA-2 final cross page_attribution 0.883203125 passes its 0.85 screen while ordinal_MAE_max 0.35999951392847995 fails its 0.10 screen; corrected ECA-2 final pages page_attribution 0.24775390625 fails and ordinal_MAE_max 0.36104662390189335 fails. Page relevance is largely recoverable in the joint reader while raw extent is not. Supplying the actual ordered rubric stage descriptions may restore extent identifiability without widening the architecture or touching relevance.
design_under_test.single_change: The value/extent path only. Relevance, orientation and knownness equations are unchanged.

unchanged_paths.attention: softmax over relevance with the frozen page mask and frozen uniform-attention policy; unchanged
unchanged_paths.direction: direction_j = tanh(z_j . (Wqd h_q)/sqrt(64)); rank 64; bias-free; unchanged
unchanged_paths.knownness: sigmoid(bk + softplus(uk) max_j relevance_j - softplus(vk) sum_j a_j (value_j - sum_l a_l value_l)^2); scalars unchanged
unchanged_paths.relevance: z_j = Wp h_page_j; relevance_j = z_j . (Wqa h_q)/sqrt(64); rank 64; bias-free; unchanged

design_under_test.value_equation: raw_value_j = sigmoid(w_v . htilde_page_j + w_r . htilde_anchor + b_v); htilde_page_j is the page block under the unchanged checkpoint train-only normalizer; htilde_anchor is the anchor block under a new train-only normalizer fit on the distinct train anchors only; w_v and b_v retain their frozen shapes; w_r is one new bias-free 384-to-1 map.

checks: number of distinct anchors equals the number of active properties in the phase
each anchor is nonempty, finite after encoding, and distinct from every other active anchor
anchor block rank >= 2 over active anchors
no anchor contains a Unicode digit, a stage heading, or a grade_order label
no anchor equals or contains any question or page text of its property
every anchor tokenizes within the pinned 128-token limit with truncate disabled; any over-length anchor fails the run closed with no per-property exclusion and no truncation
anchor feature cache key includes only anchor text hash plus encoder lineage; no target or page identity enters the key
no anchor string appears in any DecisionIR field other than the new anchor input
S0_custody.failure: fail closed; the design is unrunnable under this protocol; do not weaken the audit or re-author text
S0_custody.kind: mechanical, zero encoder forwards beyond anchor encoding, zero optimizer steps

S1_augmented_linear_ceiling.design: bias-free FP64 least squares with numpy.linalg.lstsq(rcond=None) on unique supervised train page texts in the augmented space [normalized page feature ; normalized anchor feature], predicting raw extent; same unique-text fit population, same page normalization and same solver policy as the measured page-only ceiling
S1_augmented_linear_ceiling.fail_reading: extent identifiability is not the binding constraint in the frozen linear space; retire rubric grounding and open minimal final-layer encoder adaptation under a separate protocol; no neural fit is authorized
S1_augmented_linear_ceiling.kind: CPU-only, FP64, zero optimizer steps, zero new encoder forwards beyond anchor encoding
S1_augmented_linear_ceiling.pass_reading: the augmented frozen linear space carries held-out extent information the page-only space does not; a later neural DEV failure is then a negative result for this head/optimization route
S1_augmented_linear_ceiling.required_diagnostics: rank, condition, train MSE, unidentified coefficient directions, normal-equation residual, independent SciPy GELSS second solver agreement, and raw unclipped prediction range
S1_augmented_linear_ceiling.scope: finite pinned bias-free linear function class on the frozen representation; not a ranking bound and not proof that semantic information is absent
S1_augmented_linear_ceiling.screen: DEV unique-text family macro MAE must be <= 0.3332298906765268 (page-only DEV value 0.3832298906765268 minus a predeclared absolute margin of 0.05). Validation must not be used to satisfy or fail this screen.
S1_augmented_linear_ceiling.validation_prohibition: Report validation only as a reuse diagnostic. Passing or failing S1 on validation is prohibited.

S2_neural_dev_run.ablations: evaluation-time only, no retraining: rubric_blind sets w_r to zero; zero_anchor sets the anchor block to zero; zero_pages sets the page block to zero; zero_question uses the existing intervention; uniform_attention uses the existing intervention
S2_neural_dev_run.absolute_gates: all of atomic_choice_macro >= 0.80, ordinal_MAE_max <= 0.10, orientation >= 0.90, page_attribution >= 0.85, UNKNOWN_precision >= 0.90, UNKNOWN_recall >= 0.90, supported_coverage >= 0.90, composition >= 0.80, teacher_changing_correct_new >= 0.80, permutation_rename_reorder == 1.0

S2_neural_dev_run.evaluation: development split; report the parent gate set with status development_screen
S2_neural_dev_run.exact_literals: parent-owned closed/runtime prerequisite; not re-measured here and not credited
S2_neural_dev_run.fit: pages_rubric_anchor fit under the inherited frozen constants; all five existing controls remain frozen and are not refit or re-selected
S2_neural_dev_run.kind: single new arm, frozen recipe, DEV only
S2_neural_dev_run.required_reports: every objective component per epoch, training histories, optimizer and validation row hashes, anchor feature and token hashes, actual encoder forward counters, and all DEV decision rows

failure_branches.1_extent_not_binding: If extent identifiability is not the binding constraint (S1 fails, or the anchor-specific mechanism claim fails while absolute gates pass, or extent improves but the full task still fails), retire rubric grounding and open minimal final-layer encoder adaptation under a separate preregistered protocol. Do not widen heads, add layers, or re-author evaluation text here.
failure_branches.2_dev_passes: If DEV passes, require replication on seeds 7, 11 and 13 with fresh independently audited wording before any promotion. The untouched ECA-2 final stays closed; promotion additionally requires a separate final protocol. Old DEV success earns no capability credit.
failure_branches.3_dev_fails: If DEV fails, record the negative evidence verbatim in the durable record and do not widen capacity. A finite DEV negative does not establish absence of semantic information in all encoder states.
failure_branches.not_authorized: no arm, threshold, seed, epoch, prompt, pooling or capacity selection from DEV outcomes; no B-STEF; no endgame completion claim

corrected_dev_pages_factorial_readings.page_attribution_note: 0.260498 in every cell except oracle-relevance cells, where it is 1.0
corrected_dev_pages_factorial_readings.reading: extent, orientation and knownness are each individually binding; relevance alone is actively harmful without knownness; the exact compiler and exact teacher solve the task when all three semantic components are correct

finite_linear_page_feature_ceiling.design: bias-free FP64 least squares on the cached 384-d page feature only, fit on unique supervised train page texts
finite_linear_page_feature_ceiling.reading: the cached page feature does not linearly identify extent even with exact fitting on every unique supervised text; a rubric-anchor feature that is itself a frozen final-layer mean is unlikely to fix extent unless the anchor changes what the encoder can represent for the page; this is the reason the design must be falsifiable and the reason the augmented ceiling screen below is mandatory
finite_linear_page_feature_ceiling.validation_note: Do not cite the validation ceiling as evidence that extent is unidentifiable. It measures reuse of fit-population texts.
finite_linear_page_feature_ceiling.validation_reading: MEASURED validation unique-text family macro MAE 0.21770556 over 180 unique page texts equals the train unique-text count, and validation worlds reuse prefinal property page texts; development holds 240 unique page texts, 60 of them unseen in fit. The page-only ceiling therefore nearly interpolates same-text validation while failing on genuinely new development texts. Held-out generalization of the page-only frozen linear extent map is the failing quantity, and any augmented ceiling must be screened on development, never on validation.

inferred: supplying the ordered rubric scale as model-visible text may restore extent identifiability, because the joint reader already recovers page relevance while extent is the failing component

the inference is weak: the linear ceiling shows the frozen final-layer page mean does not linearly identify extent even when fit exactly, so an anchor that is itself a frozen final-layer mean is unlikely to help unless the anchor changes what the encoder represents for the page; the design's only live mechanism is joint optimization of the new value path against the anchor, and the design is expected to fail S1 unless the anchor adds genuine scale information
the audit conditions (a) to (d) are satisfiable for the prefinal property rubrics, but this is unverified until the independent review runs

parent_decision_tree.authorized_branch_text: Retire only these demonstrated inadequate frozen final-mean/readout interfaces, not semantic information in all encoder states. Use component oracle/linear ceilings to preregister one targeted representation change on fresh material: minimal final-layer task adaptation if semantic match/polarity is limiting, or explicit caller-supplied ordinal rubric grounding if grade identifiability is limiting. Do not repeat global numeric reconstruction, arbitrarily widen heads, or select on closed ECA final.
parent_decision_tree.selected_mechanism: explicit caller-supplied ordinal rubric grounding (rubric anchor) on the value/extent path
parent_decision_tree.source_pre_amendment_sha256_role: value pinned by the corrected-final result manifest next_branch before the correctness amendment; the on-disk file is the post-amendment byte state
parent_decision_tree.why_not_final_layer_adaptation_first: The DEV privileged-substitution factorial shows extent, orientation and knownness each individually binding, and the finite linear page-feature ceiling shows the frozen 384-d page mean does not linearly identify extent on held-out development page texts (family macro MAE 0.38322989 over 240 unique texts) even when fit exactly on all 180 unique supervised train page texts; its 0.21770556 validation figure reflects reuse of fit-population texts and is not evidence about new text. The rubric anchor is the cheapest change that adds model-visible scale information without touching relevance, orientation or knownness, and it is falsifiable before any GPU spend. Minimal final-layer encoder adaptation is deferred to failure branch 1.
